name: Engine Air Filter
summary: Element part number 13717542294 for E90 328i/328xi (N52, 2007+) is confirmed by two independent retailers (Bimmerworld, Turner), neither a BMW document. The general removal sequence (loosen intake-hose clamp, remove two airbox fastener(s), unplug MAF, lift airbox, split halves, swap element, reverse) is consistent across three sources, but one is a 2006 325i thread and one is an E89 Z4 TIS excerpt, so exact fastener sizes/counts are SINGLE_SOURCE. No torque values exist in any source (hand-tight only). N51 fitment is unverified.
variantDependencies: Engine: 13717542294 is listed for N52 (2007+ 328i/328xi). N51B30 airbox/filter fitment NOT found.
Z4 TIS excerpt is for an N52K (E89), not E90; used only to corroborate sequence.
xDrive vs RWD: Turner lists same filter for 328i and 328xi; no procedure difference reported.
Transmission type is irrelevant to this job (no source suggests a dependency).
Euro airbox conversion filter (Mann 13717536006) is a different airbox; not applicable to a stock US car unless converted.

tools.item: T25 Torx (airbox half screws) / Torx driver
tools.status: VERIFIED (BW lists T25; BP lists a Torx driver, size unstated)
VERIFIED (secondary sources only, no BMW document)

tools.item: Pick or small pry tool for MAF connector clip
tools.status: VERIFIED (secondary sources only, no BMW document)

parts.status: VERIFIED (secondary sources only, no BMW document) (two independent retailers)

parts.item: Mann N52 Euro airbox filter (not stock airbox)
Airbox screws (listed on bavmods page, identity unclear)

steps.title: Prep
steps.instruction: Switch the engine off and let it cool. One source says disconnect the battery negative terminal first (to protect the MAF); the Z4 TIS excerpt only says switch off ignition and read fault memory first.
steps.status: CONFLICT (BW: disconnect battery; Z4 TIS: ignition off)
warnings: Battery disconnect will reset some settings; decide with owner.

steps.title: Loosen intake hose clamp
steps.instruction: Loosen the band clamp on the rubber intake hose at the airbox outlet and free the hose.

steps.title: Remove airbox mounting fasteners
steps.instruction: Remove the two fasteners holding the airbox (10 mm per BW; BP calls them two large bolts on the right side at the fender).
steps.status: VERIFIED for count of two (BW, BP); size SINGLE_SOURCE

steps.title: Release intake snorkel/duct
steps.instruction: Release the front intake snorkel by unlatching its retention tabs.
steps.status: VERIFIED (BW, BP, Z4 mention removing intake duct)

steps.title: Handle MAF connector
steps.instruction: Unplug the mass airflow sensor by lifting its small retention clip. BP says the wire has enough slack to leave it attached and let the box hang; BW and Z4 unplug it.
warnings: The sensor clip is small and brittle; one owner broke it. Do not strain the wire.

steps.title: Lift out airbox
steps.instruction: Lift the airbox straight up off its lower rubber stud and out.

steps.title: Open airbox and swap element
steps.instruction: Turn the box over, remove the housing screws (six per BW), separate the halves, remove the old element, wipe out debris, seat the new element with its gasket properly.
steps.status: SINGLE_SOURCE for screw count; general step verified (BW, BP)
warnings: Do not run the engine with a loosely seated element.

steps.title: Reassemble
steps.instruction: Close the halves, tighten screws evenly by hand, refit airbox onto the lower stud (may need wiggling; a smear of silicone on the grommet is suggested by one Z4 poster), reconnect MAF, hose and clamp, snorkel and the two fasteners.

steps.title: Test
steps.instruction: Reconnect battery if removed, start engine, check for fault lights and intake leaks.

safety: Do not let the MAF wire or connector take strain.
Never reinstall a visibly damaged element or run without the filter.
Avoid oiled aftermarket filters that can contaminate the MAF (BP warns about this).
missingEvidence: BMW/TIS procedure for the E90 N52 airbox and torque values.
BMW service interval for engine air filter (bavmods suggests 12,000-15,000 mi/1 yr; single source, not BMW).
Exact housing screw drive size and count confirmed on an E90.
Whether battery disconnect or fault-memory step is required.
ownerInputsNeeded: Confirm stock airbox (not a Euro airbox or aftermarket intake).
